The journal aims to be a leading peer-reviewed platform and an authoritative source of information for analyses, reviews and evaluations related to energy.\"}, {\"title\": \"Energy - Wikipedia\", \"url\": \"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Energy\", \"snippet\": \"Energy (from Ancient Greek ἐνέργεια (enérgeia) 'activity') is the quantitative property that is transferred to a body or to a physical system, recognizable in the capacity to do work and in the form of heat and light.\"}, {\"title\": \"ENERGY（英语单词）_百度百科\", \"url\": \"https://baike.baidu.com/item/energy/16835218\", \"snippet\": \"作为多学科交叉术语，其内涵分为四类：生物个体的体力与活力、个人或集体的行动力、专注特定目标的努力（使用复数energies），以及驱动机械或产生热力的自然能源（如电能）。 常见短语如potential energy（势能）、renewable energy（可再生能源）等，应用于物理、生态及能源政策领域。 词源上，energy源自希腊语“energeia”（意指行动力），经拉丁语和古法语传入英语。 16世纪起用于描述“力量展现”，19世纪随热力学发展确立科学定义，如能量守恒定律。 20世纪后，工业需求与环保运动推动其“可持续能源”含义成为全球议题的关键概念。 n. 能力，力气；精力，活力；能源；能，能量.\"}, {\"title\": \"Energy | Definition, Types, Examples, & Facts | Britannica\", \"url\": \"https://www.britannica.com/science/energy\", \"snippet\": \"Energy is fundamentally the capacity to perform work, whereas power is the time rate of doing work or delivering energy. In the International System of Units (SI), energy is measured in joule s (J). One joule is equal to the work done by a one- newton force acting over a one-meter distance.\"}, {\"title\": \"What Is Energy?
